cohort: Preterm infants born at 22-26 weeks gestational age in Spain
finding: Changes in perinatal care, including increased use of antenatal steroids, cesarean section, and CPAP during resuscitation, were associated with increased survival and survival without major morbidity in preterm infants born at 22-26 weeks gestational age in Spain between 2002-2006 and 2007-2011.
mod_finding: Delivery by C-section increased from 41.8% to 48.3% between the two study periods (p < 0.001).
